steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each pay input is matched to its source, and each line to the cut-off date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 pay input differs from its source

findings.title: Pay input differs from its source
findings.fix: Correct the input before the run

findings.title: Total does not reconcile
findings.fix: Reconcile the total to the bank

findings.title: Line after the cut-off date
findings.fix: Move the line to the next cycle

outcome.notChecked: The statutory deductions and their rules, which a payroll specialist confirms.
